purpose: Five standalone image concepts for owner selection; live site is unchanged.

concepts.name: Earthen Atelier
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE finished, striking desktop homepage design IMAGE for ALKEBULAN, a contemporary African fashion label. This is a visual direction to choose, not code, a wireframe, a moodboard, a laptop scene, or a collage of multiple screens. Fill a crisp landscape 3:2 image with the actual webpage, viewed perfectly front-on. Hero approximately 78% of image height, attractive start of the collection section below. High-end art direction, excellent typography, sensible clickable navigation and shop action, exceptionally polished composition and clear hierarchy. A contemporary African creative house: cultural depth through materials, spatial design, and graphic rhythm. Avoid generic safari imagery, random masks, made-up sacred symbols, or invented claims of historical authenticity. No fabricated customer quotes, ratings, discounts, prices, stock counts, partner logos or awards. Clearly legible wordmark ALKEBULAN. Existing shop links: Collection, Men, Women, Our story. Minimal search and bag icons.
Reference image 1 is the EXISTING SELECTED WEBSITE: preserve its sophisticated fashion attitude, generous space and clear product focus, but substantially re-art-direct it as directed below. Subsequent references are the owner's REAL product photos, in order Ijele, Durbar, Dùn Dùn. Use those same black tees and preserve the exact visible printed artwork, lettering, garment cut and colors. Carefully isolate from their gray photograph backgrounds when compositing into the hero; do not redesign the garments or add props to the prints. Small supporting product images must also use those originals. Product art is the authentic identity anchor. Generate only surrounding architecture, textile textures, graphics and interface design. All decorative material studies are contemporary creative concepts. Do not add a fake historical artifact.
Only concise, exact copy specified below; tiny neutral interface labels are fine. No long paragraphs. Place the small concept number and name specified below neatly in a thin top presentation strip, separate from the website navigation.

DIRECTION 01 / EARTHEN ATELIER. This is the warm, architectural evolution closest to the selected design. Palette bone-white chalk plaster, burnt sienna, clay, dark espresso with restrained copper. Float a fine ivory capsule navigation with ALKEBULAN left. In the hero, the real Ijele shirt floats at realistic scale inside a grand rounded terracotta portal occupying the middle-right. The portal has three beautiful concentric sculpted clay contours, hand-finished grain, warm raking sunlight and subtle architectural shadows; contemporary West African material sensibility without claiming a named historic building. A broad terracotta incised-line relief sweeps through the lower background like a rhythmic topographic landscape, echoing the selected orange waves in a far more tactile way. Left of the arch, an extraordinarily beautiful huge black editorial headline, bold condensed 'CULTURE' over refined italic serif 'in motion.' Keep lettering separate from the garment silhouette, plenty of quiet cream. Under headline: 'African roots. Unrestricted expression.' and an espresso rounded 'Shop the collection' button with fine arrow. Small floating paper label near garment bottom: 'Ijele / Wearable artwork'. Tiny row '01 Ijele   02 Durbar   03 Dùn Dùn'. At bottom, a gently curved cream section begins, 'The wearable archive' and an elegant preview of the three original pieces. One narrow band of subtle handwoven natural textile adds craft detail. This must feel tactile, sunlit, expensive and future-facing, not rustic craft-shop branding. Top presentation label exact: '01 / EARTHEN ATELIER'.

DIRECTION 02 / INDIGO ARCHIVE. A bold contemporary textile editorial, dramatically DIFFERENT composition from the cream central arch. DIRECTION 03 / BRONZE AFTER DARK. A cinematic nocturnal African luxury fashion gallery. A full-width monumental abstract circular bronze sculpture / torus with subtly hammered metal and precise concentric incised lines fills the center-right as a luminous portal. Navigation directly on dark with hairline bronze bottom rule, wordmark ALKEBULAN cream left and spare nav right, no excessive glassmorphism. Bottom a dark three-piece horizontal collection ribbon with faint bronze dividers and original garment thumbnails. Immaculate night-gallery visual, powerful negative space, editorial tension, far more considered than generic black-and-gold luxury. Top presentation label exact: '03 / BRONZE AFTER DARK'.

DIRECTION 05 / WOVEN FUTURES. A breathtaking quiet-futurist African textile couture webpage in ivory, toasted ochre, palm-dark green and espresso. Small editorial garment label integrated into thin line grid: 'Ijele / Wearable artwork'. The weave flows behind and under the garment and gently crosses the hero baseline, retaining airy premium composition. Lower page reveals a stone-white gallery band with three original product previews and headline 'The wearable archive', thin green rules, small elegant labels.
